events.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
events.summary: Hey everyone, here is some info about Steam Deck compatibility for Golden Retriever Simple Life.The game performs well on Steam Deck.You’ll mostly use the touchpad and R2 to navigate.You can also use the touchscreen, it works great too!Touch controls currently don't work for drag-and-drop actions (placing stickers, adjusting option sliders, or shaking the cursor). Use R2 and the touchpad for those.Have fun!

events.title: Small fix with cursor shaking
events.summary: Fixed a bug where moving slowly the mouse cursor to the left would trigger glittering. It now correctly only triggers when shaking the cursor.
